Strawberry Moon to be visible in India on June 29

The Strawberry Moon, the full moon of June, is set to be visible in India on June 29. While the name refers to the season of strawberry harvesting in North America, the moon itself is not expected to turn red. Several outlets provided astrological interpretations and viewing times for the event.
